channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Kingspan Turns to Bond Market as Data Center Demand Lifts Firm
item.description: Kingspan Group Plc is looking to raise an expected €800 million ($925 million) from a two-part green bond sale, after the AI data center buildout helped the Irish company lift its profit outlook last month.
item.dc:creator: Ronan Martin

item.title: Renault-Backed Wandercraft Seeks €100 Million in New Funding
item.description: Wandercraft, the French robotics startup backed by Renault SA, is seeking about €100 million ($116 million) in fresh funding to expand its business, people with knowledge of the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Vinicy Chan

item.title: Horizons Middle East & Africa 9/2/2026
item.description: Horizons Middle East & Africa is your daily spotlight on one of the world's fastest-growing regions. Live from Dubai, we bring you the latest global markets and analysis, plus news-making interviews, with a special focus on MEA. All that and more, as you head to the office in the Gulf, pause for lunch in Hong Kong, or start your day in London or Johannesburg. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia May Be Close to $14 Billion Deal for Hugging Face
item.description: Nvidia is in advanced talks to acquire artificial intelligence startup Hugging Face in a transaction that may total about $14 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Matt Bloxham has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Homeplus Creditors Vote to Accept Korean Mart’s Turnaround Plan
item.description: Creditors of South Korean megamart Homeplus agreed on Wednesday to accept a rehabilitation plan aimed at keeping the company afloat.
item.dc:creator: Haram Lim

item.title: GPTC CEO on Business Strategy, Chip Industry
item.description: Hoton Chang, Chairman and CEO at GPTC, discusses the company's business strategy and the demand for advanced packaging in the semiconductor industry. He speaks with Stephen Engle from the sidelines of SEMICON Taiwan in Taipei. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trumpf CTO on Business Strategy, Chip Industry
item.description: Berthold Schmidt, Chief Technology Officer at German industrial laser maker Trumpf, discusses the company's business strategy and the outlook for the semiconductor industry. He speaks with Stephen Engle from the sidelines of SEMICON Taiwan in Taipei. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: SEMI CEO on Memory Prices, Semiconductor Supercycle
item.description: Ajit Manocha, President and CEO of semiconductor industry association SEMI, discusses the outlook for memory chip prices and the ongoing supercycle in the semiconductor market. He speaks with Stephen Engle on the sidelines of SEMICON Taiwan in Taipei. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Phison Electronics Sees Worst NAND Shortage in 2027
item.description: Phison Electronics Corporation Co-Founder and CEO KS Pua believes NAND flash memory may face its worst shortage next year. He also discusses NAND's role in artificial intelligence. Phison Electronics designs, makes and sells controller chips for NAND flash memory used in solid-state drives , USB drives and memory cards. He speaks with Stephen Engle from the sidelines of 'Semicon Taiwan 2026'. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Data Center Spending to Reach $32 Trillion by 2050, PwC Says
item.description: Global data center spending is set to reach $31.6 trillion through 2050 to meet the world’s growing appetite for AI, an investment boom with no precedent in history, according to PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP.
item.dc:creator: Saritha Rai

item.title: Nvidia Partner Gets Strong Demand for Rare GPU-Tied Loan in Asia
item.description: GMI Cloud, an Nvidia Corp. partner, secured commitments for more than double the amount it was seeking in a loan backed by the sale of computing power from advanced chips, underscoring strong demand for one of the first such deals in Asia.
item.dc:creator: Aileen Chuang

item.title: AI Startup Cognition Set to Raise Around $1 Billion at a $47 Billion Value
item.description: Artificial intelligence coding startup Cognition AI Inc. is set to close a new round of funding that would vault its valuation to about $47 billion, according to people familiar with the efforts.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Torrence and Edward Ludlow

item.title: Nvidia Nears $14 Billion Hugging Face Deal This Week
item.description: Nvidia Corp. is in advanced talks to acquire artificial intelligence startup Hugging Face in a transaction that may total about $14 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gould, Ian King and Rachel Metz

item.title: Stocks Slide as Oil Surges & Treasury Yields Rise | The Close 9/1/2026
item.description: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Dimensional Fund Advisors Founder & Chairman David Booth, T. Rowe Price CEO Rob Sharps, Christian & Timbers Founder & CEO Jeff Christian, New York Life Investment Management Global Market Strategist Julia Hermann, Founder ETFs Partner & Portfolio Manager Michael Monaghan, Evercore Equity Analyst Peter Levine, KIND Snacks Founder Daniel Lubetzky, & ValueEdge Advisors Chair Nell Minow. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: NYLIM's Hermann Says Bond Market Signals Tighter Rates
item.description: Julia Hermann, Global Market Strategist at New York Life Investment Management, says the recent move in bonds is warning equity investors to pay closer attention to interest rates. In her view, markets are heading into a tighter rates environment over the next few months, but the key question is whether the pressure comes from the front end of the curve through an imminent Fed tightening cycle or from the long end through further Treasury selloff and higher long-term yields. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AWS Invests in AI Entertainment
item.description: Amazon Web Services is working with Amazon MGM Studios on a major new initiative at the intersection of AI and entertainment: A gen AI film fund and a new AI production platform for participating up-and-coming filmmakers. AWS General Manager, Media, Entertainment, Games and Sports Samira Bakhtiar discusses the imitative and how the company is pioneering a new era of mobile entertainment in order to tap into more Gen Z viewers. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: T. Rowe Price's Jodi Love Discusses Active Small & Mid-Cap ETFs
item.description: Jodi Love, Lead Portfolio Manager for T. Rowe Price’s Active Small and Mid-Cap ETF lineup, joins Romaine Bostick live on-site at the T. Rowe Price Headquarters in Baltimore, MD. Love notes that these funds are a frequent topic of client questions. She goes on to highlight that T. Rowe Price’s active ETFs have just crossed a three-year benchmark. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Dropbox User Accounts Breached by Hackers Who Accessed Data
item.description: Hackers broke into thousands of Dropbox Inc. accounts last month, viewing and downloading material users kept on the cloud-storage platform, according to a company statement and records seen by Bloomberg News.
item.dc:creator: Jake Bleiberg

item.title: Apple Sets Pay Targets at $58 Million for Ternus, $47 Million for Cook
item.description: Apple Inc. said that new Chief Executive Officer John Ternus will get a compensation package worth about $58 million in fiscal 2027, while Tim Cook’s role as executive chairman will pay around $47 million.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Profit Outlook Tops Estimates, Margins Narrow
item.description: The cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks Inc. issued a profit outlook for the year that exceeded Wall Street’s expectations, fueled by corporate demand for stronger defenses against advancing artificial intelligence systems.
item.dc:creator: Ignacio Gonzalez
